settings.size_help: Compression pieces run true to size and are meant to be tight — a loose rash guard is a handle for your opponent. Between sizes on compression? Take the smaller size. Relaxed pieces run true to size; size down only for a closer crop.
settings.shipping_returns: Free shipping on orders over $100. 30-day money-back guarantee. Wrong size? Email us your measurements and we will exchange it — you keep the piece until the replacement lands.

settings.heading: Fit & Fabric

settings.question: How do I pick my size?
settings.answer: Use the size chart above — every number is a body measurement in inches, taken over a sports bra with the tape snug and level. Compression pieces run true to size and should feel tight; if you are between sizes, take the smaller one. Relaxed pieces also run true to size. If you are still unsure, email us your measurements and what you train and we will tell you which size to take.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit?
settings.answer: Every order is covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee. If it is a fit issue, we will exchange it for the right size rather than just refunding you — email us and we will sort the size out for you.

settings.question: How should I wash it?
settings.answer: Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colors — and wash training gear the same day you train in it. Do not bleach. Hang dry where possible: heat is what kills the elastane and the silicone grippers, not the washing. Never iron a print.

settings.question: Who is King Killers?
settings.answer: King Killers is a fighter-owned combat sports apparel brand based in Tampa / St. Petersburg, Florida, founded in 2021 by professional fighter Michael "Heck" Heckert. We make apparel for MMA, BJJ, boxing, Muay Thai and strength athletes, and we wear-test everything before it ships.
